title: Istio出口TLS故障：应用和代理重复发起TLS
body:
## 操作任务
实现task.py的repair(client)，当proxy_tls_origination为SIMPLE且客户端scheme为https时，只将客户端scheme改为http，返回深拷贝并保留代理TLS、CA和其他字段。题目中客户端到本地私有代理使用HTTP，代理到私有上游进行CA和IP SAN校验的TLS；原HTTPS客户端会把另一层TLS ClientHello送入已加密连接，受控上游因此无法按HTTP处理。

## 产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Envoy、私有TLS上游和直接TLS健康对照。

## 能力边界
仅验证自有网络命名空间、loopback和受控代理TCP链；不经过真实Istio控制面，HTTP仅限本题应用到本地代理链路，不代表生产中明文链路均可接受。未验证外部生产CA、网格配置或业务恢复。
answer: 确认客户端是否已发起TLS以及代理是否又发起TLS；按批准架构统一一层TLS并保持上游证书验证。
explanation: 双重TLS可能使上游在单层解密后收到另一个TLS握手而非HTTP；直接上游正常不代表代理路径配置正确。
rubric: 直接TLS健康，代理错误路径出现内层ClientHello；调整本地客户端协议后请求成功且上游TLS验证保留。
review_note: 原模块故障场景真实缺口，新增题号绑定冻结空名额；不计原214故障和旧题改编。

exercise.environment: 私有WSL普通student；实际Envoy、私有grpcio和自有user/net namespace
exercise.operation: 只调整应用到本地代理的协议，保留代理出口TLS与CA。
exercise.validation_scope: 仅验证自有网络命名空间、loopback和受控代理TCP链；不经过真实Istio控制面，HTTP仅限本题应用到本地代理链路，不代表生产中明文链路均可接受。未验证外部生产CA、网格配置或业务恢复。

import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
before=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net');p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-Urn','--',sys.executable,'-B','checks/rls_worker.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
print(p.stdout,flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr;assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')==before
assert 'NATIVE_ENVOY_PLAINTEXT_LOCAL_CLIENT_TLS_ORIGINATION_SUCCESS_CA_SAN_PRESERVED' in p.stdout
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
test_files.checks/rls_worker.py:
import copy,http.client,os,pathlib,socketserver,ssl,subprocess,sys,tempfile,threading,urllib.parse
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
import task
from envoy_fixture import Envoy,bootstrap
from private_tls import certificate
assert os.getuid()==0
subprocess.run(['ip','link','set','lo','up'],check=True,capture_output=True)
events=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-double-tls-') as name:
 root=pathlib.Path(name);cert,context=certificate(root)
 class Handler(socketserver.BaseRequestHandler):
  def handle(self):
   data=self.request.recv(4096)
   if data.startswith(b'\x16\x03'):
    events.append('nested_tls');self.request.sendall(b'HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n')
   elif data.startswith(b'GET '):
    events.append('plain_http');self.request.sendall(b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nOK')
   else:events.append('other')
 class Server(socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer):
  allow_reuse_address=True;daemon_threads=True
  def get_request(self):
   sock,addr=super().get_request();return context.wrap_socket(sock,server_side=True),addr
 server=Server(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,kwargs={'poll_interval':.02},daemon=True);thread.start()
 try:
  direct=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',server.server_address[1],context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cert)),timeout=3);direct.request('GET','/');response=direct.getresponse();assert response.status==200 and response.read()==b'OK';direct.close()
  config=bootstrap(server.server_address[1]);config['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters']=[{'name':'envoy.filters.network.tcp_proxy','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.tcp_proxy.v3.TcpProxy','stat_prefix':'tcp','cluster':'service'}}]
  config['static_resources']['clusters'][0]['transport_socket']={'name':'envoy.transport_sockets.tls','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.UpstreamTlsContext','sni':'127.0.0.1','common_tls_context':{'validation_context':{'trusted_ca':{'filename':str(cert)},'match_typed_subject_alt_names':[{'san_type':'IP_ADDRESS','matcher':{'exact':'127.0.0.1'}}]}}}}
  client={'scheme':'https','host':'127.0.0.1','proxy_tls_origination':'SIMPLE','trusted_ca':str(cert),'path':'/'};original=copy.deepcopy(client)
  with Envoy(config) as proxy:
   port=urllib.parse.urlsplit(proxy.base).port
   bad=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',port,context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cert)),timeout=3)
   try:bad.request('GET','/');bad.getresponse()
   except (ssl.SSLError,OSError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
   else:raise AssertionError('nested TLS unexpectedly succeeded')
   finally:bad.close()
   assert events==['plain_http','nested_tls'],events
   print('NATIVE_ENVOY_UPSTREAM_TLS_RECEIVED_NESTED_CLIENT_HELLO_DIRECT_TLS_HEALTHY',flush=True)
   print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:align_plain_client_to_tls_originating_proxy',flush=True)
   try:fixed=task.repair(client)
   except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('approved client scheme repair failed') from error
   expected=copy.deepcopy(original);expected['scheme']='http';assert client==original and fixed==expected
   good=http.client.HTTPConnection(fixed['host'],port,timeout=3);good.request('GET',fixed['path']);response=good.getresponse();assert response.status==200 and response.read()==b'OK';good.close()
   assert events==['plain_http','nested_tls','plain_http'],events
   print('NATIVE_ENVOY_PLAINTEXT_LOCAL_CLIENT_TLS_ORIGINATION_SUCCESS_CA_SAN_PRESERVED',flush=True)
 finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(3)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
test_files.checks/private_tls.py:
"""Private verified TLS fixtures; ephemeral CA files never enter host trust or default credentials."""
import contextlib,datetime,ipaddress,json,pathlib,ssl,threading,urllib.request,urllib.error
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
def certificate(root):
 root=pathlib.Path(root);root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048)
 name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'OpsForge ephemeral private TLS fixture')])
 cert=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(name).issuer_name(name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=None),critical=True).add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.IPAddress(ipaddress.ip_address('127.0.0.1'))]),critical=False).sign(key,hashes.SHA256())
 pem=root/'ca.pem';private=root/'key.pem';pem.write_bytes(cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM));private.write_bytes(key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption()))
 context=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER);context.load_cert_chain(str(pem),str(private));return pem,context
@contextlib.contextmanager
def server(root,handler):
 pem,context=certificate(root);http=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),handler);http.daemon_threads=True;http.socket=context.wrap_socket(http.socket,server_side=True)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=http.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
 try:yield 'https://127.0.0.1:'+str(http.server_port),pem
 finally:http.shutdown();http.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
def client(cafile,jar=None):
 context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cafile));handlers=[urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=context)]
 if jar is not None:handlers.append(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
 opener=urllib.request.build_opener(*handlers)
 def call(method,url,payload=None,headers=None):
  req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else (b'' if method=='POST' else None),method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json',**(headers or {})})
  try:
   with opener.open(req,timeout=4) as r:status,raw,response_headers=r.status,r.read().decode(),dict(r.headers)
  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status,raw,response_headers=e.code,e.read().decode(),dict(e.headers)
  try:body=json.loads(raw)
  except ValueError:body=raw
  return status,body,response_headers
 return call
